name: Flow
description: Modern flowchart pieces: a step card with a title and a description, a hexagonal decision with named yes/no exits, a switch that branches a value into a row per case, a coloured callout, a swimlane and a start/end pill. Cards rather than the 1970s template shapes - the classical vocabulary of diamonds and parallelograms is in the UML library. Everything sizes itself to its text rather than clipping it, and every colour is a theme token.
